sources.entry: GlitchTip - Error tracking app to collect errors reported by your app. (Source Code) MIT Python/Docker/K8S

summary.name: GlitchTip
summary.one_liner: GlitchTip is an open source, Sentry API compatible error tracking platform that collects application errors, performance data and uptime checks in one place.
use_cases: Self-host an error tracker compatible with Sentry SDKs
Monitor website or app uptime alongside errors
Replace a costlier Sentry plan with a cheaper option
summary.what_it_does: GlitchTip collects exceptions, log messages and Content Security Policy violations from websites and applications into one place for triage and resolution. It works with Sentry's open source client SDKs to receive error data, so existing Sentry-instrumented apps can send data to it. It also offers performance monitoring and site uptime checks. GlitchTip is open source and can be run on your own server or hosted by its maker, with hosted plans priced by monthly event volume and retention. Alerts can be sent to chosen destinations.
notable: Sentry API and SDK compatible, but described as easier to run
Open source (MIT per awesome-selfhosted listing) and self-hostable or hosted by the maker
Combines error tracking, performance monitoring and uptime checks
Created by Burke Software and Consulting, which also made Passit
caveats: Hosted plans are paid tiers with event limits (free Hobby tier up to 1,000 events/mo; higher tiers cost more)
Event retention and support levels vary by plan
Hosted tiers are limited by monthly event volume
